verdict.rationale: Abacum's own marketing describes an AI Modeler that builds financial models "in plain language" with no formulas, and AI that runs inside the model to answer questions. That is a first-party natural-language interface for core modeling. The evidence is thin marketing copy, though, and does not show natural-language commands driving the rest of the product. Missing for 10: evidence that natural language can drive actions beyond model building and Q&A (e.g., reporting, scenario changes, data integration), detailed documentation of the command interface, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
